name: Ann Snowden
source:
A calm and gentle girl, who is always smiling.
She is actually a quite unfortunate girl who had been greeted by one month full of misfortune that can be enough for a whole lifetime. She had lost both of her parents, lost sight of anything good in this world, and nearly exhausted from life.
Because of this she has been waiting for a messiah to help her find happiness in her life again.
She is good at singing.

[Roughly translated from [url=http://sunset77light.rdy.jp/sikkoku/t_top.html]the official website[/url].]
